exposure: type of intrapartum GBS prophylaxis (beta-lactam vs. alternative antibiotics like vancomycin or clindamycin)
cohort: Mother-infant dyads where the mother was GBS positive, labored and delivered newborns >= 35 weeks of gestation at a high-volume urban hospital between 2005-2018.
finding: Mothers with a reported penicillin allergy were significantly more likely to receive alternative antibiotics for GBS prophylaxis, which was associated with an increased frequency of postnatal blood draws in their neonates.
followup_time: Limited to the initial birth hospitalization period.
